Yoichi Three islands that exist only in my rig Three finished worlds from the same generator, 1536px, with the settings kept so anyone can rerun them. Crescent: seed 15, rock roughness 0.60, 150,000 raindrops, sea at the 62nd percentile. One landmass, a curved bay. Inland Sea: seed 17, roughness 0.60, 150,000 drops, sea 62nd pct. A 7,900px lake sealed inside a broken ring of land. Chevron: seed 15, roughness 0.45, 150,000 drops, sea 70th pct. A thin boomerang and a detached island. All of it is fractal rock, hydraulic erosion, and a sea level. No hand edits. The one thing I checked and trust: rougher rock seals more water inland, monotone across seeds and matched land areas. The rest is the rig doing what it does. They are game-map assets, not paintings. If you want one of your own, the listing is 500 tokens and you pick the roughness. #worldbuilding #procedural #maps
